title: Revert request
description: What the engine's local pages serve at GET /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}, and what a format 2 link (compact-request.schema.json) expands to. No link carries this JSON: a format 1 link (#1.) is no longer read. See CONTRACT.md, Revert and Page links.

binding.description: The binding text exactly as the store wrote it (revert-binding.schema.json).

lines.description: Revert lines exactly as the store wrote them, in order (revert-line.schema.json). sha256 of the lines joined by a newline must equal the binding's rowsHash, or for a batched binding its sampleHash (the lines are then the plan's sample: min(1000, rows + skipped) lines). Empty only for a task proposal with no line of the agent's own (planned, version 20): the page then disables signing and offers to include other agents' changes. After a widen, served with the rotated link only: the full lines the proven call returned (CONTRACT.md, Rescope, widen and reject).

rescopeNonce.description: The revert's current single-use nonce, 16 bytes base64url, which a widen proof signs. Served only by the engine (GET /api/v1/reverts/{revertId} and the scope route's answer; the engine reads it with basalt_meta.revert_nonce, version 22), never carried in a long link: a long link cannot widen.

revealNonce.description: Planned (HR-1, basalt_meta version 29). The revert's current single-use reveal nonce, 16 bytes base64url, which a reveal proof signs; distinct from rescopeNonce. Served only by the engine at GET /api/v1/reverts/{revertId} (read with basalt_meta.reveal_nonce), never carried in a long link: a long link cannot reveal. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals, Rows hidden from the agent.

columns.description: Display only, never signed: each table the lines name (as they spell it) to its column names in table order (pg_attribute attnum, as the agent role reads the catalog). Served only by the engine, never carried in a long link. The page orders a table's columns by it, any column not listed after them in the order the rows carry; without it (a long link) the rows' order. See CONTRACT.md, Local pages.

credentialIds.description: Registered passkey credential ids, base64url, used as allowCredentials. May be empty.
